from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import joblib
import pandas as pd
import pytest
from fraud.model import fit, scores
from fraud.policy import decisions
from fraud.serve import score_request

@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def frame():
    return pd.read_csv("data/train.csv")

def test_schema(frame):
    assert frame.row_id.is_unique and set(frame.outcome) == {0, 1}

def test_service(frame):
    model = fit(frame)
    assert 0 <= score_request(frame.iloc[0].to_dict(), model) <= 1

def test_artifact_roundtrip(tmp_path):
    model, out = tmp_path / "model.joblib", tmp_path / "predictions.csv"
    a = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "fraud.train", "--data", "data/train.csv", "--out", str(model)], capture_output=True)
    assert a.returncode == 0, a.stderr.decode()
    b = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "fraud.predict", "--model", str(model), "--input", "data/holdout_features.csv", "--out", str(out)], capture_output=True)
    assert b.returncode == 0, b.stderr.decode()
    assert len(pd.read_csv(out)) == 600

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import joblib
import pandas as pd
from fraud.model import scores
from fraud.policy import decisions

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--model", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--input", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    a = p.parse_args()
    frame = pd.read_csv(a.input)
    model = joblib.load(a.model)
    values = scores(frame, model)
    Path(a.out).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    pd.DataFrame({"row_id": frame.row_id, "score": values,
                  "decision": decisions(frame, values)}).to_csv(a.out, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from fraud.features import matrix

def fit(frame):
    clf = LogisticRegression(C=1, random_state=7, max_iter=200)
    return clf.fit(matrix(frame), frame["outcome"])

def scores(frame, model):
    clf = model["classifier"] if isinstance(model, dict) else model
    return clf.predict_proba(matrix(frame))[:, 1]
